highlights: Persistent memory compression system built for Claude Code.
Claude-Mem seamlessly preserves context across sessions by automatically capturing tool usage observations, generating semantic summaries, and making them available to future sessions.
This enables Claude to maintain continuity of knowledge about projects even after sessions end or reconnect.
Restart Claude Code or Gemini CLI.
